I've opened #37322 with a few minor edits to the files for the GNS construction. While writing up my work I found some ways to make a few (what I consider to be) simplifications. In the changes, I

  • fixed a typo in a docstring
  • shortened the proof of preGNS_norm_sq (although it's a bit more opaque now, so I understand if it's not really an improvement)
  • refactored the proof of map_zero' so it follows directly from map_smul' (again, I would understand if this isn't really an improvement, because I had to add another private lemma)
  • shortened Completion.induction_on to induction_on (the Completion namespace was already open anyway)
  • got rid of names of some variables that were never explicitly referenced

None of these changes are particularly important or change the API at all, but I would appreciate it if it could be reviewed soon, just so I will know what state the code will be in, in Mathlib, when I finish writing my senior thesis.

@Jireh Loreaux @Monica Omar

@Gregory Wickham we have some changes to GNS stuff downstream, which we will likely upstream soonish. Now that your code is in Mathlib, it may not stay the way you want / wrote it. So, if you want to reference a particular version, just pin that version of Mathlib in your thesis. Nevertheless, I will review this soon.
